title: 技術架構與技術債顧問
description: 評估技術路線、找出架構風險與技術債，將複雜系統轉成可執行的改善路線圖。
descriptionEn: Assess technical direction, expose architecture risks and technical debt, and turn complex systems into an executable improvement roadmap.

title: 跨系統整合與資料流重整
description: 重整破碎的資料流與服務邊界，整合客服、CRM、電商、RMA 與內部工具，讓營運流程可以可靠地運作。
descriptionEn: Rebuild fragmented data flows and service boundaries across customer support, CRM, e-commerce, RMA, and internal tools so operations can run reliably.

title: 工程團隊與產品落地
description: 在需要時直接進場，帶領工程團隊把架構、產品與交付流程做對、做完。
descriptionEn: Step in directly when needed to lead engineering teams through architecture, product delivery, and execution.

title: 技術盡職調查與投資判斷
description: 協助創投、投資人或決策者判斷技術可信度、系統風險、團隊執行能力與後續投資成本。
descriptionEn: Help investors and decision-makers assess technical credibility, system risk, team execution capability, and the cost of future investment.
